name: English Language Lab
sem: I or II (group-wise; alternative to Environmental Studies AHT-004)
objectives: Facilitate software based learning to provide the required English language proficiency to students.
Acquaint students with specific dimensions of communication skills i.e. Reading, Writing, Listening, Thinking and Speaking.
Train students to use correct and error-free writing by being well versed in rules of English grammar.
Cultivate relevant technical style of communication and presentation at the work place and for academic uses.
Enable students to apply it for practical and oral presentation purposes by being honed up in presentation skills and voice dynamics.
outcomes: CO1 Understand the basic objective of the course by being acquainted with specific dimensions of communication skills i.e. Reading, Writing, Listening, Thinking and Speaking.

CO2 Create a substantial base by the formation of strong professional vocabulary for application at different platforms and through numerous modes such as comprehension, reading, writing and speaking.
CO3 Apply it at the work place for writing purposes such as presentation / official drafting / administrative communication and use it for document / project / report / research paper writing.

CO4 Evaluate the correct and error-free writing by being well versed in rules of English grammar and cultivate relevant technical style of communication and presentation at the work place and for academic uses.

CO5 Apply it for practical and oral presentation purposes by being honed up in presentation skills and voice dynamics; apply techniques for developing interpersonal communication skills and positive attitude leading to professional competence.

note: Credit 0 (L-T-P 0-0-2). Marks in the scheme table: sessional 50, practical exam 25, total 75.

exps.title: 1 Group Discussion: Practical based on Accurate and Current Grammatical Patterns.
exps.aim: Take part in group discussions using accurate, current grammar.
exps.formula: GD flow: initiate → build points → respond to others → summarise
viva: Listen, be concise, be polite, support with facts, do not interrupt.
Any participant, ideally toward the end.

exps.title: 2 Conversational Skills for Interviews under suitable Professional Communication Lab conditions with emphasis on Kinesics.
exps.aim: Practise interview conversation with attention to body language.
exps.apparatus: Language lab, mock interview setup, video recorder
exps.formula: Kinesics = body language: posture, eye contact, gesture, facial expression
viva: The study of body movements and gestures in communication.
How to answer 'Tell me about yourself'?
Give a brief, relevant summary of education, skills and goals.

exps.title: 3 Communication Skills for Seminars / Conferences / Workshops with emphasis on Paralinguistic / Kinesics.
exps.aim: Practise communicating at seminars and workshops using voice and body cues.
exps.formula: Paralanguage = pitch, pace, volume, tone, pauses
viva: Vocal cues such as tone, pitch and pace that accompany speech.
To emphasise points and let the audience absorb them.

exps.title: 4 Presentation Skills for Technical Paper / Project Reports / Professional Reports based on proper Stress and Intonation Mechanics.
exps.aim: Present technical papers and reports with correct stress and intonation.
exps.formula: Structure: introduction, body, conclusion; stress key words, falling tone for statements
viva: The rise and fall of the voice in speech.
Emphasis on a particular syllable of a word.

exps.title: 5 Official / Public Speaking based on suitable Rhythmic Patterns.
exps.aim: Deliver official or public speeches with proper rhythm.
viva: The regular pattern of stressed and unstressed syllables.
Prepare, practise, breathe slowly and focus on the message.

exps.title: 6 Theme Presentation / Keynote Presentation based on correct methodologies argumentation.
exps.aim: Prepare and deliver a theme or keynote presentation with logical argument.
viva: A main speech that sets the central theme of a conference.
Clear claim supported by relevant evidence and logic.

exps.title: 7 Individual Speech Delivery / Conferencing with skills to defend Interjections / Quizzes.
exps.aim: Deliver an individual speech and handle interruptions and questions.
exps.formula: Handling questions: listen, pause, answer briefly, stay calm
viva: Acknowledge politely, respond briefly and return to the point.
A word that expresses sudden emotion, e.g. oh, wow.

exps.title: 8 Argumentative Skills / Role Play Presentation with Stress and Intonation.
exps.aim: Practise arguing a point and role playing with proper stress and intonation.
exps.formula: Persuasion: stress key words and vary intonation
viva: Acting out a situation to practise communication.
Acknowledge the other view, then give your reasons.

exps.title: 9 Misplaced modifiers, Articles, Prepositions.
exps.aim: Correct sentences with misplaced modifiers and use articles and prepositions properly.
exps.formula: Place the modifier next to the word it describes; a/an before a consonant/vowel sound; the for specific nouns
viva: A modifier placed away from the word it modifies, causing confusion.
'An hour', because hour starts with a vowel sound.

exps.title: 10 Phonetic symbols.
exps.aim: Learn and use IPA symbols to read and write pronunciations.
exps.apparatus: Language lab software, English pronouncing dictionary
exps.formula: English has 44 sounds: 20 vowels (12 monophthongs, 8 diphthongs) and 24 consonants
viva: How many diphthongs does English have?

exps.title: 11 Everyday conversation, Identifying Common Errors in Writing: Subject - verb agreement.
exps.aim: Practise everyday dialogues and correct subject-verb agreement errors.
exps.formula: Singular subject takes singular verb; plural takes plural; 'each', 'every', 'neither' take singular
viva: 'The team is winning' when the team acts as one unit.

exps.title: 12 Writing Practices: Comprehension, Précis Writing.
exps.aim: Practise answering comprehension passages and writing précis.
exps.formula: Précis ≈ one-third of the original passage, in own words, with a title
viva: A concise summary of a passage in your own words.
